name: Harmonica
group: Things people make > Toys > Make music with it > Blow into it

features.claim: It is a small instrument played with the mouth by blowing into holes in its side.
features.quote: A harmonica is small musical instrument that is played with the mouth by blowing into holes in its side.

features.claim: It has a mouthpiece that covers one edge along most of its length, with holes along it.
features.quote: The harmonica is played by using the lips and tongue to direct air into or out of one (or more) holes along a mouthpiece (which covers one edge of the harmonica for most of its length).

features.claim: The basic parts are the comb, the reed plates and the cover plates.
features.quote: The basic parts of the harmonica are the comb, reed plates, and cover plates.

features.claim: The comb looks like a hair comb, which may be where its name comes from.
features.quote: The term "comb" may originate from the similarity between this part of a harmonica and a hair comb.

features.claim: Each reed is a flat, long spring fixed at one end over a slot.
features.quote: The harmonica reed is a flat, elongated spring typically made of brass, stainless steel, or bronze, which is secured at one end over a slot that serves as an airway.

features.claim: The cover plates cover the reed plates and are usually made of metal.
features.quote: Cover plates cover the reed plates and are usually made of metal, though wood and plastic have also been used.

features.claim: The mouthpiece sits between the air chambers and the player's mouth.
features.quote: The mouthpiece is placed between the air chambers of the instrument and the player's mouth.

second_reading.claim: Behind each hole is a chamber that holds at least one reed.
second_reading.quote: Behind each hole is a chamber containing at least one reed.

second_reading.claim: The comb is the main body and forms the air chambers for the reeds.
second_reading.quote: The comb is the main body of the instrument, which, when assembled with the reed plates, forms air chambers for the reeds.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it

second_reading.claim: The reed plate is a group of several reeds held in a single housing.
second_reading.quote: The reed plate is a grouping of several reeds in a single housing.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it

second_reading.claim: The reeds are usually made of brass.
second_reading.quote: The reeds are usually made of brass, but steel, aluminium, and plastic are occasionally used.

second_reading.claim: The most common kind has ten air passages and twenty reeds.
second_reading.quote: The most common type of harmonica is a diatonic Richter-tuned instrument with ten air passages and twenty reeds, often called a blues harp.

second_reading.claim: Players disagree about whether the material of the comb changes the tone.
second_reading.quote: Dispute exists among players about whether comb material affects the tone of a harmonica.
